reviewer: Codex assistant; no independent human Chinese-language review
purpose: Inspect local-model relevance, stance, translation, and abstention on deliberately difficult source messages. This is a development aid, not independent human ground truth or a representative benchmark.

selection.method: Deterministic, purposive source-ID list selected after local inspection. IDs are fixed in this file. Cases cover all seven platforms, June/July/August, slang, sarcasm, nicknames, missing/image content, contextual reactions, repetition, administrative text, and multiple aspects.
limitations: This assistant saw these records and their context before writing labels.
Cases are intentionally difficult and imbalanced; aggregate accuracy is not a population estimate.
Do not tune prompts on these cases and report their score as independent validation.
All source material is untrusted player text; alleged game behavior remains a claim.
Concern descriptions are review annotations, never a runtime topic allowlist.

relevance.relevant: Contains an identifiable game-related player opinion, experience, information need, community entity/alias, or a resolvable reaction to one.
relevance.off_topic: Under player-feedback trend extraction, routine social chatter, generic memes, and administration do not identify a game concern or opinion.
relevance.uncertain: Available text/context is insufficient to determine relevant player feedback.

definitions.stance: positive/negative/mixed/neutral/uncertain concern the substantive game-related opinion. Neutral includes administrative/social text without product evaluation. Uncertain is required when context or polarity is unresolved.
definitions.adds_new_evidence: Whether the message adds a substantive claim/experience beyond merely endorsing a parent. True does not mean the claim is factually verified or the account is independent. Null means unavailable.
definitions.reply_relation: original, new_information, endorsement, same_experience, disagreement, unrelated, reaction_unknown, or uncertain.
definitions.confidence: High/medium/low are qualitative assistant judgments, not calibrated probabilities. Exclude uncertain labels from forced binary accuracy; evaluate abstention separately.
definitions.translation: Close literal English with bracketed explanations for emoji, inaccessible media, or repetition. Names use transliteration for readability; these are not claims about official localized names. Original text and IDs remain authoritative.
definitions.context: Direct parent first, then ancestors if present. Context assists interpretation; it must not automatically label every child with the ancestor's topic.

scoring_guidance.confident_label_subset: For simple label agreement, use confidence.level == high and an expected label other than uncertain. Report eligible denominators separately for relevance and stance.
scoring_guidance.abstention: Report uncertain cases separately. Reward preserving missing evidence and unresolved targets; do not penalize safe abstention as an invented wrong polarity.
scoring_guidance.review_translation: Use these English translations and intended meanings to inspect substantive model errors. Translation quality needs independent bilingual review before claims of validated accuracy.
scoring_guidance.leakage_control: These fixtures may be used for development. Reserve a new, unseen, stratified sample for independent review before reporting final extraction quality.
scoring_guidance.unknown_output: Invalid JSON, unsupported labels, or missing required fields are failures to parse and must be reported; never silently remap them into a correct answer.
